prompt: High-fidelity desktop web application UI comp, 1536x1024 landscape, for a French personal productivity app named BrainDump. OPERATE product screen, not a poster and not marketing. Dark refined blue-gray visual system, matte surfaces, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no photography, no decorative illustration. Precisionist industrial-plate composition translated into a calm productivity interface: overlapping flat planes, hard-edged depth hierarchy, restrained rust-orange action accent, slate and chalk text, one raking-light emphasis only on the active capture plane. Three-column layout: left navigation, Inbox list, right detail editor.
